name: jump_box110
description: Approach 110 mm box at .1 m/s while running the assumed jump cycle, including post-settle recovery.

expected.note: DecisionParams.jump_min_h=.03 <= .110 <= jump_max_h=.12; jump_at_s = 1 s is the start of CROUCH (simcam contract).

Jump gate spec (#169 table, tools/jump_gate): UNCERTAIN from CROUCH start until SETTLE dwell is met = LAND tick (CROUCH+1.07 s rounded to the 10 Hz tick) + 0.3 s dwell. The scripted SETTLE lasts 0.40 s but the gate may return to STAND earlier by design.
Research gate returns to STAND after SETTLE; rebuild DecisionParams.confirm_n=3 fresh samples, no cached EMA promotion.
